source: Proposal H12 of the 2d-gratnig campaign (R4-A); libraries/grating-mask-search/docs/cyclic_geometric_vnd.md, its verbatim sections

proposal.title: Cyclic variable-neighborhood descent with geometric displacement
proposal.mechanism:
Every candidate is a full 128-row by 256-column row-major binary mask. Score at RCWA(10,5); maximize actual J=(TE+TM)/2, log TE/TM/min separately. Archive completed finite actual binary scores only. One seeded RNG; exact full-mask cache: hits require no new solve but all time charged. Check externally supplied worker deadline at every outer/generation/cache/init/restart loop and before calls; stop with best valid archive or no solution if none, without completing interrupted phases. Individual blocking calls require supervisor timeout. Failure/nonfinite call is charged, not cached/archived, and terminates cleanly. Log requests/cache hits/attempted/completed uncached dual-polarization calls/failures/exposed physical forward work and optimizer counters; backward count zero. Include generation/hash/cache/bookkeeping in full-worker time. No scored seed sharing absent declaration. All rule counts are algorithm specifications, not allocations. All three are custom/unattached; evaluator readiness does not make these custom procedures runnable. Partial initialization always returns best available valid mask at expiry; initial score ties and global archive ties use earliest completed first insertion. No symmetry/fill/min-feature constraints introduced.

Each coarse draw independently samples Bernoulli(0.5) on 8 rows by 16 columns, expanding each bit into a 16-row by 16-column pixel block. This is only initialization/restart bias, not a geometry constraint on subsequent full-mask operators.

Apply common contract and coarse-draw definition verbatim. Initialize up to four coarse draws and start current at best valid completed score. Separate global archive survives all restarts. Three neighborhoods in order: 0 square inversion, side uniform {1,2,4,8,16}; 1 rectangle content displacement, height/width independently uniform {4,8,16,32}, extract toroidal rectangle, cyclically rotate its INTERNAL contents one pixel along uniform x/y axis with uniform sign and paste into same rectangle; 2 paired-square inversion, side uniform {1,2,4,8}, independent uniform origins, XOR both regions so overlap cancels. Every origin uniform full-grid cell. Start index0; accept J gain>1e-12 relative current, resetting index and rejection counter to zero. Rejection increments counter; at 16 rejections advance index modulo3 and clear rejection counter. All evaluation requests, including cache hits and proposals identical to current, count once as requests; identical-current score comes from cache. Global no-gain request counter resets on archive improvement, otherwise increments once. At 96 no-gain requests restart current from ONE coarse draw regardless of quality, retaining archive; reset index/rejection/no-gain counters. Restart draw is logged but does not count toward the 96-request stall counter. Do not additionally retry duplicates or make hidden duplicate counters: each loop generates exactly one proposal, checks deadline and cache, then accepts/rejects once. If neighborhood switch and restart thresholds coincide, restart takes precedence. Expiry during any initialization/restart returns existing archive.

Responsibilities: the optimizer_v1 package only proposes and observes. The worker owns physical evaluation, the exact evaluation cache, deadlines, timeouts, failure charging and full-worker timing. Each propose returns exactly one request, duplicates included, and each observe makes one decision; a cache hit reported by the worker still counts as a request.
proposal.rationale: Cyclic neighborhoods retain local refinement, geometry-preserving displacement and separated coordinated edits without H09's nonstationary gain-credit arrays/warmup. One-request proposals keep control overhead small; accepting a new restart state permits basin changes while only the true best is returned.
